meta.title: Bohdan Moroz — full-stack engineer
meta.description: Bohdan Moroz — full-stack TypeScript engineer. Four years building production web and mobile apps for US logistics, HR, and fintech teams. Open to freelance work.

facts.infraValue: CI/CD · Docker · self-host · Ollama / vLLM / LiteLLM
facts.workingValue: Remote · In person if you're in Sofia

work.heading: Things I've built, mostly for US SMBs.

projects.title: ClaraHR
projects.desc: Onboarding system for US truck drivers — a bot collects info over chat and registers them in the carrier's system, replacing manual HR back-and-forth. Microservices on NestJS, Next.js portal, Vite admin panel, full CI/CD with unit and integration tests. I own the server side.

projects.title: CargoHub
projects.desc: Public freight marketplace where US shippers and brokers browse partner carriers' trucks, post loads, and book capacity directly — with accounts, live tracking, and document flow built in. An in-product AI assistant handles routine booking and dispatch steps.

projects.title: CargoFinance
projects.desc: Accounting and light-fintech tooling for a logistics back-office — invoicing, transfer tracking, payouts. Focused on getting an unfamiliar domain (AP/AR, reconciliation) into something operators could actually use.

projects.title: CargoETL
projects.desc: Closed TMS platform for US logistics carriers and dispatchers. Built and maintained the Next.js dispatcher dashboard and the React Native (Expo) driver app — order flow, live tracking, document handling, dispatch comms.

projects.title: Altek TMS
projects.desc: Earlier TMS for US logistics carriers and dispatchers — Vue / Nuxt dispatcher dashboard plus a pure React Native driver app covering order flow, live tracking, and dispatch comms. My first multi-year production project; service has since wound down.

howIWork.heading: What hiring me actually looks like.

items.text: End-to-end ownership. Comfortable taking a feature from a half-formed Figma or a paragraph of requirements all the way through frontend, backend, infrastructure, and deploy — without needing handoffs along the way.

TypeScript across the stack: React / Next.js on the web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS on the server. CI/CD and Docker by default; self-host on my own infra when it makes sense, happy on AWS / Vercel / Hetzner when it doesn't.

Agentic AI is built into how I work — Claude and Codex agents handle the typing while I drive the architecture, review, and integration. Comfortable running self-hosted models too — Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM — for work that can't ship traffic to OpenAI or Anthropic. Usually means meaningfully more shipped per week than a hands-on-keyboard pace.
Async-friendly and used to working with US clients from Sofia, Bulgaria (UTC+2). Work in English, Ukrainian, and Russian. Most of my career has been remote across time zones.

contact.heading: The fastest way to reach me is email.
contact.body: I read everything that lands in my inbox and reply within a day. Tell me a bit about the project — stack, timeline, what you're trying to ship — and we'll go from there. If you're in Sofia, I'm happy to meet in person — at your office, or at my coworking (WorkBetter 1.0) if that's easier.
